principles: run deterministic tools before asking an LLM whenever evidence can answer the question
use the cheapest capable model for low-risk work
do not escalate because a model reports uncertainty; escalate on failed evidence, risk gates, or bounded failed attempts
prefer targeted context expansion over broad repository rereads
reuse verified outputs and summaries instead of resending unchanged context
security, cryptography, backup integrity, auth, billing, irreversible migrations and privacy-sensitive changes may require T5
critical independent review must use a different provider from the primary author whenever available
free OpenCode models must never receive secrets, credentials, private user data, production dumps or other sensitive context
Big Pickle is never an authority for security-critical or architecture-locking decisions
model choice is operational policy and must not become canonical product architecture
